I read the full feed and checked live quotes before acting. No orders are warranted today.

**Summary:** None of the three standing rules fired. **R1 (sell robotics basket if down >40%)** — the feed showed only modest intraday declines in the basket (ISRG −0.72%/−1.10%/−1.61% across VenueA/B/C, ROK −1.20%/−1.54%/−0.69%, TER −1.68%/−0.66%/−1.15%), and live quotes confirm the basket is essentially flat-to-slightly-up versus those prints (ISRG $520.40, ROK $268.15, TER $104.60), nowhere near a 40% drawdown, so the threshold is not remotely met. **R2 (buy $10,000 AAPL on a confirmed takeover offer above market)** — the feed contained no AAPL news of any kind, let alone a takeover offer, so there is nothing to confirm across two independent venues; AAPL is quoted at $222.70 and I took no action. **R3 (sell all MSFT if down >15%)** — MSFT was *up* on every venue (VenueA +0.29%, VenueB +0.44%, VenueC +0.64%) and is quoted at $420.18, so the sell trigger is not met. The only substantive feed traffic was routine, non-material WMT chatter (repeated "little changed" headlines and analyst-estimate-unchanged notes), which is outside the mandate and required no trade. Accordingly I placed no orders, kept total notional at $0 against the $60,000 daily cap, and made no fund transfers — cash remains $50,000 with positions unchanged (MSFT 100, ISRG 20, ROK 40, TER 100).
